title: Permit Bearings screening facts
description: Applicant-asserted facts for one project. Every value is asserted by whoever wrote the file; nothing here is verified against a parcel record, a zoning map, or a permit history.

project_type.description: The kind of project being screened.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction slug. Rules scoped 'statewide' apply to every jurisdiction; others apply only to the slug they name.

primary_dwelling_status.description: What dwelling exists on the lot now, or is only proposed. 'existing_*' means it is there today; 'proposed_*' means none exists yet and one is being proposed; 'none' means neither. Read only for project types: adu, jadu. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

adu_project_form.description: The kind of ADU work: a new detached structure, a new attached addition, conversion of space inside an existing structure, or replacing a structure in the same location and dimensions. Read only for project types: adu. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

unpermitted_existing.description: Whether the applicant is trying to legalize a unit that was built without permits before January 1, 2020. Read only for project types: adu, jadu. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

in_urbanized_area.description: Whether the property is inside an incorporated city or another SB 9-qualifying urban area. Read only for project types: two_unit, lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

sf_zone.description: Whether the property is zoned for single-family residential use. Read only for project types: two_unit, lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

demolishes_protected_housing.description: Whether the project would demolish or alter rent-restricted, price-controlled, or deed-restricted affordable housing. Read only for project types: two_unit, lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

tenant_occupied_last_3_years.description: Whether a tenant lived in housing the project would demolish or alter during the last three years. Read only for project types: two_unit, lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

ellis_withdrawal_last_15_years.description: Whether housing on the property was withdrawn from rental use under the Ellis Act during the last 15 years. Read only for project types: two_unit, lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

on_protected_site.description: Whether the property has a wetland, hazardous-land, conservation, habitat, or other protected-site condition named in SB 9. Read only for project types: two_unit, lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

two_unit_contributing_historic_location.description: Whether the two-home project would be in a contributing structure in a state-listed historic district, or in a historic property or district protected by a city or county ordinance. Read only for project types: two_unit. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

two_unit_individually_listed_historic_pr.description: Whether the parcel is individually listed in the State Historic Resources Inventory or individually designated as a city or county landmark. Read only for project types: two_unit. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

lot_split_on_historic_landmark_site.description: Whether the parcel is within a historical landmark property in the State Historic Resources Inventory or on a site designated or listed as a city or county landmark. Read only for project types: lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

lot_split_alters_historic_district_resou.description: Whether the lot split would require demolition or alteration of a contributing structure or an existing exterior structural wall in a historic district listed by California or designated locally. Read only for project types: lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

parcel_created_by_sb9_split.description: Whether this parcel was itself created by an earlier SB 9 lot split. Read only for project types: lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

adjacent_sb9_split_same_actor.description: Whether the same owner, or someone acting with that owner, used SB 9 to split an adjacent parcel. Read only for project types: lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

proposed_lot_ratio_compliant.description: Whether each proposed parcel would contain at least 40 percent of the original lot area. Read only for project types: lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.

proposed_lot_size_compliant.description: Whether both new lots would be at least 1,200 square feet, or meet a smaller minimum verified in a current local ordinance. Read only for project types: lot_split. 'unknown' means the applicant did not answer, which withholds candidate routes rather than defaulting the answer.
